create_MLAAttention_layer: create an MLAAttention layer with configured head dimensions and quantization settings
build_MLACommonMetadata: build MLACommonMetadata from common attention metadata for prefill and decode splits
run_MLACommonImpl_forward_mha: run forward_mha on MLACommonImpl to compute multi-head attention with latent KV cache

get_mla_dims_from_config: get MLA dimensions such as kv_lora_rank and head dims from a model config
